Real producer price index and year-over-year price change
Source: food and agriculture: annual agricultural producer price indices and yea…

data.caption: Real Producer Price Index against Year-over-Year Real Price Change, shown to answer evaluate whether higher deflated producer price indices are correlated with annual real price percentage changes. The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Statistics Division compiled country-level agricultural producer prices deflated by consumer price indices alongside gross per-capita agricultural output from 2005 to 2023. The dataset evaluates terms of trade shocks, commodity-specific volatility, and structural agricultural output differences across global income classifications.
